[![OpenSSF Best Practices](https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/7551/badge)](https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/7551) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.scorecard.dev/projects/github.com/kubernetes-sigs/headlamp/badge)](https://scorecard.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/kubernetes-sigs/headlamp) [![FOSSA Status](https://app.fossa.com/api/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2Fheadlamp-k8s%2Fheadlamp.svg?type=shield)](https://app.fossa.com/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2Fheadlamp-k8s%2Fheadlamp?ref=badge_shield) Headlamp is an easy-to-use and extensible Kubernetes web UI. Headlamp lets you view and manage Kubernetes resources through a graphical interface, with plugins to extend its functionality.
## Features - Vendor-independent Kubernetes UI - Runs in-cluster or locally as a desktop app - Multi-cluster support - Extensible through [plugins](https://github.com/headlamp-k8s/plugins) - UI controls that reflect user permissions - Clean, modern UI - Cancellable create, update, and delete operations - Logs, terminal access, and a resource editor with documentation - Read and write access based on user permissions ## Screenshots
## Quick start To deploy Headlamp in your cluster, follow the [in-cluster installation guide](https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/installation/in-cluster/). Container images are published as `ghcr.io/headlamp-k8s/headlamp` on [GitHub Container Registry](https://github.com/orgs/headlamp-k8s/packages). To run Headlamp locally, install the [desktop application](https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/installation/desktop/) for [Linux](https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/installation/desktop/linux-installation), [macOS](https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/installation/desktop/mac-installation), or [Windows](https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/installation/desktop/win-installation). Make sure your kubeconfig is configured for the clusters you want to access. See the [desktop configuration options](https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/installation/desktop/#use-a-non-default-kube-config-file) to use a non-default kubeconfig file or multiple files. ### Access and permissions Headlamp uses Kubernetes [role-based access control (RBAC)](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/rbac) to determine which resources you can view and which actions you can perform. The resources available in Headlamp depend on the permissions granted to your credentials. For token-based authentication, see how to [create a service account token](https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/installation/#create-a-service-account-token). ## Quick start for contributors Want to hack on Headlamp? We'd love your help! See the [contributing guidelines](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for local development setup, build instructions, and platform-specific tips. For more detailed documentation, see the [development guide](https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/development/). ## Tested platforms See the [Kubernetes platforms](./docs/platforms.md) Headlamp has been tested with. Please contribute results for other platforms or report regressions. ## Extensions and plugins Browse [Headlamp plugins on Artifact Hub](https://artifacthub.io/packages/search?kind=21&sort=relevance&page=1) for published plugins. See the [plugins repository](https://github.com/headlamp-k8s/plugins) for official plugins. ### Plugin development To extend Headlamp for your use cases, see the [plugin development guide](https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/development/plugins/). ## Get involved Join the community and contribute: - [Contribution guidelines](https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/contributing/) - [Code of Conduct](./code-of-conduct.md) - [#headlamp channel on Kubernetes Slack](https://kubernetes.slack.com/messages/headlamp) - [Monthly community meeting](https://zoom-lfx.platform.linuxfoundation.org/meetings/headlamp) ## Roadmap and release planning Track upcoming releases in [GitHub milestones](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/headlamp/milestones) and proposed changes in [GitHub issues](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/headlamp/issues). See the [release notes](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/headlamp/releases) for changes in published versions. ## License Headlamp is released under the terms of the [Apache 2.0](./LICENSE) license. ## Frequently asked questions For more information about Headlamp, see the [Headlamp FAQ](https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/faq/).
